metadata.description: FP.ai agentic extensions for Financial Portfolios AI subscribers — interact with your model portfolios, run analysis and visualizations, and prepare broker orders, all from an LLM client via MCP.

plugins.name: fpai-portfolio
plugins.description: Connect to your Financial Portfolios AI account (MCP) and explore, analyze and visualize your model portfolios: holdings, allocations, history, performance, winners/losers.

plugins.name: fpai-research
plugins.description: Put the companies in your model portfolios in context — news, filings and fundamentals from a connected market-data MCP, joined to the holdings and the portal's own research, with every outside fact attributed. Requires fpai-portfolio for the MCP connection.

plugins.name: fpai-broker
plugins.description: Convert a Financial Portfolios AI model portfolio into reviewable order tickets and hand them to a brokerage MCP (Interactive Brokers, Robinhood, Alpaca, …) — propose → confirm, never auto-execute.
